item.description: AI companies could be legally required to report rogue incidents such as the hacking of another company, under a proposal from the Albanese government as part of its plans for new safety, environmental and industrial rules for the technology. Fuente: ABC News Australia.
item.dc:creator: Cam Wilson

Nirmeen Noufl was sentenced on Friday to at least three years in jail after pleading guilty in August to killing her husband, Mamdouh Noufl, in excessive self-defence while she was being choked and… Fuente: The Guardian - World.
item.dc:creator: Australian Associated Press

item.title: Sydney woman sentenced to minimum three years' jail over husband's killing
item.description: A woman who killed and dismembered her husband before disposing of his remains in bins around south-west Sydney has been handed a minimum jail term of three years. Fuente: ABC News Australia.
item.dc:creator: Jamie McKinnell

item.title: Australia’s Sydney Airport staff shortages prompt plan to close tower overnight
item.description: Australia’s major airlines have backed a proposal to close Sydney Airport’s control tower overnight to free up air traffic controllers, the latest step to address a persistent labour shortage that is disrupting flights and raising safety concerns. “It sounds like an opportunity we should absolutely explore,” said Stephen Beckett, chief executive officer of Airlines for Australia & New Zealand, the group that represents Qantas Airways, its low-cost carrier Jetstar, and Virgin Australia Holdings.... Fuente: South China Morning Post.
item.dc:creator: Bloomberg,Reuters

item.title: A-League season start under threat with referees on strike
item.description: The A-League Men and Women seasons are just one month away. However, that start date is at risk as the nation's referees go on strike over "detrimental" and "untenable" changes over their work conditions. Fuente: ABC News Australia.
item.dc:creator: Simon Smale

item.title: Runaway Tasmanian devil back on display at wildlife park after weeks on the run
item.description: The runaway Tasmanian devil has spent months in recovery after escaping from her enclosure and going missing in bushland on the Gold Coast. Fuente: ABC News Australia.

item.title: LA driver charged over bus collision before fatal news helicopter crash
item.description: Bailee Lynn Rios was speeding and drug-affected when she drove her SUV the wrong way down a busy avenue and struck a vehicle before ploughing into a bus, prosecutors say. Fuente: ABC News Australia.

item.title: School holidays flight disruption fear as QantasLink staff say strike likely
item.description: School holidays start in Queensland, Victoria and the Northern Territory next week, and planned Qantaslink industrial action could hit regional flights and freight. Fuente: ABC News Australia.
item.dc:creator: Alison Branley and Alex Turner-Cohen

item.title: Loophole closed after rare private prosecution shuts Hepburn council
item.description: Earlier this year, businessman David Penman brought charges against five of the Hepburn Shire Council's seven councillors, who were forced to stand down. Fuente: ABC News Australia.
item.dc:creator: Coco Veldkamp, Eden Hynninen, and Laura Mayers

item.title: After disciplining a developer, this watchdog went quiet
item.description: A major developer was disciplined. A media release was drafted. Then nothing. Why did NSW's building watchdog go quiet? Fuente: ABC News Australia.
item.dc:creator: Amy Greenbank

item.title: Taipan crash inquiry leads to recommendation for Defence report review
item.description: The senate inquiry, which began its hearings in June, heard claims an independent Defence Flight Safety Bureau (DFSB) had been corrupted by a conflict of interest and contained "manipulated" evidence. Fuente: ABC News Australia.
item.dc:creator: Laura Lavelle

item.title: K'gari resort set to be sold to US travel giant
item.description: K'gari's Kingfisher Bay Resort is set to be taken over by US-owned "experiential tourism" giant Journey Beyond. Fuente: ABC News Australia.
item.dc:creator: James C Taylor

item.title: Trump seen looking at plans for Kennedy Center demolition
item.description: A judge has blocked any immediate efforts to destroy the Kennedy Center, after Donald Trump was photographed through the windows of Air Force One appearing to look at plans for the building's demolition. Fuente: ABC News Australia.

item.title: Outback nurse credits non-profit counselling service for saving career
item.description: A remote area nurse who has previously worked across the Pilbara and Kimberley is encouraging other regional nurses and midwives to seek peer-to-peer counselling if experiencing burnout, anxiety or isolation. Fuente: ABC News Australia.
item.dc:creator: Esse Deves

item.title: Fiji declares national HIV emergency as cases soar
item.description: Government estimates that one in 60 adults in Fiji now living with HIV, as escalating use of methamphetamine fuels ‘epidemic’ Fiji has declared a national HIV emergency amid a spike in infections as the Pacific nation grapples with a correlating rise in methamphetamine use. The country’s health and medical services minister, Dr Ratu Atonio Lalabalavu, said in a statement on social media that an outbreak-level response was no longer sufficient to address what he described an “epidemic”. Continue reading... Publicado también por: The Guardian - World, The New York Times - World. Fuente: ABC News Australia.

item.title: Australia cracks down on student and backpacker visas to curb migration
item.description: * Foreign students barred from bringing partners and children * Ballots to be introduced for backpackers for visa extension * Visitor visas to carry no further stay provision (Rewrites throughout Publicado también por: The Hindu - International. Fuente: The Times of India - World.

item.title: Flooded market leaves pioneering WA abalone ranch close to the end
item.description: Rare Foods Australia winds down operations amid a Chinese supply glut and falling prices for abalone, after once being the biggest employer in the WA seaside town of Augusta. Fuente: ABC News Australia.
item.dc:creator: Andrew Williams and Tara de Landgrafft

item.title: Melbourne woman set to be extradited after gun allegedly linked to Sydney killing
item.description: NSW Police are seeking to extradite a Melbourne woman after they allege they have linked a gun used in two other shootings to the death of Marco Tapia in Sydney's south-west in early September. Fuente: ABC News Australia.
item.dc:creator: Anton Rose and Olivia Jenkins

item.title: Fighting a $3 million payout, the state of WA tried to have its cake and eat it too
item.description: The Western Australian government wanted "immunity from liability" in cases brought by child sex abuse victim-survivors like Dion Barber, but the Supreme Court ruled against it. Fuente: ABC News Australia.
item.dc:creator: Keane Bourke

item.title: FBI tip-off leads to Qld 18yo being charged with violent extremism offences
item.description: Queensland police allegedly find violent extremist material and child abuse material after the FBI claimed he was operating multiple social media channels supporting violence against people of Muslim, Jewish, and migrant backgrounds. Fuente: ABC News Australia.

item.title: First Nations netballers driving change, bringing cultural safety
item.description: Netball has long lacked Indigenous representation at the elite level. The introduction of the First Nations Tournament and Black Swans are some measures the code is taking to address cultural safety. Fuente: ABC News Australia.
item.dc:creator: Kate O'Halloran

item.title: Shark attack rescuer struggling to forget the blood
item.description: Keen surfer Shannan Dunn hopes to get back in the water soon, after he was the first to assist a fellow surfer bitten by a shark this week. Fuente: ABC News Australia.
item.dc:creator: Chloe Henville and Chris Lewis

item.title: Bushfire survivor builds fire-resistant tiny home kit that fits in ute tray
item.description: Architect Adriano Pupilli creates a flat-packed tiny home that meets the second-highest bushfire attack level after enduring the 2019 Black Summer bushfires. Fuente: ABC News Australia.
item.dc:creator: Charles Rushforth

item.title: NT paramedics could carry pepper spray for safety, minister says
item.description: The NT government has floated the idea of ambulance officers carrying pepper spray and employing body-worn cameras for their safety, as assault rates against paramedics remain high. Fuente: ABC News Australia.
item.dc:creator: Emma Masters and Stewart Brash

item.title: Live: Qantas seeks to avert freight ground crew strikes
item.description: Qantas is heading to the Fair Work Commission as hundreds of ground workers plan strikes next week. Follow the day's events and insights from our business reporters on the ABC News live markets blog. Fuente: ABC News Australia.
item.dc:creator: Adelaide Miller and Lin Lin
